_comment: Divergences from stock Nightscout decided by the repository owner (CONTRIBUTING.md, U-8). Every entry links the PR comment recording the decision. 'approved' entries relax only their own documented default-configuration comparison. 'approved_opt_in' entries are allowed only behind a non-default option and never relax a default-configuration comparison. 'rejected' entries record divergences the owner refused.

E-1d.decision: At 39 mg/dL and above 400 mg/dL the card shows the number in the site unit instead of Nightscout's fixed LOW/HIGH display text; alarm state is shown in a separate badge computed by Nightscout's simplealarms rule from the site's alarm levels.

E-1b.decision: Card colour modes three, five, custom_three and custom_five paint with palettes other than the site's Nightscout theme.

E-1c.decision: Those modes may colour readings where the site's theme shows no range colour.

E-1e.decision: Home Assistant options may override each alarm threshold in mg/dL; with no override the site's served thresholds are used.

E-4a.decision: Blanking a stale glucose reading to unknown. Parity applies: keep the value and expose its age.
